summary: Bind quality evidence to the current focused shard and partition long-running macOS focused, smoke, and high-risk matrix gates without reducing supported-host coverage.

migration.note: Default local CI and smoke invocations still execute the complete unsharded gate set. Explicit focused-report and smoke-scenario parameters are additive.

compatibility.note: Windows retains full sequential jobs; Ubuntu retains complete sharded coverage; macOS executes equivalent focused, smoke, and profile-matrix coverage in smaller independently reportable jobs.
